stops.note: the meadowsweet genus, from Greek speiraia; salicylic acid was first obtained from meadowsweet (then Spiraea ulmaria) in 1839
Bayer's trademark: a- (acetyl) + spir- (Spiraea) + -in; the chemist Felix Hoffmann synthesised pure acetylsalicylic acid at Bayer in 1897
after World War I Bayer lost the trademark in Britain, France and the US under the 1919 Treaty of Versailles, and it became a common noun

current_meaning: a drug used to relieve pain and reduce fever and inflammation
